environment.notes: Record only environment details that may matter when interpreting the round later.

task.summary: Continue a real writing or design task and observe whether the work changes while using CSW.

constraints.statement: Keep source and discovery route distinct.

framework_contacts.notes: A preview was opened during the round.

residuals.statement: A contradiction appears unresolved in the current material.

reopening_conditions.statement: Revisit the unresolved relation if a new source directly addresses it.

interpretations.statement: The round appears to have produced a new research question, but this interpretation is not equivalent to a measured method effect.

notes: No score is required. Direct observations and attributed interpretations are kept separate.
